messages.content: We have a three-day school closure in October, so compare flights from Chicago to Washington for Daniel, Owen, and me. Thursday evening versus Friday morning going out, and Sunday afternoon versus Sunday evening coming back. Don't buy anything.
What are the travel dates, and will each of you have a carry-on or any checked luggage?
Thursday, October 22 or Friday, October 23 outbound, returning Sunday, October 25. Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee. We need three carry-ons total and one shared checked bag.

I found two nonstop outbound options from ORD to DCA. Thursday departs at 6:05 p.m. and arrives at 8:02 p.m.; the base fare is $209 per person. Friday departs at 8:20 a.m. and arrives at 10:12 a.m.; it is $174 per person. Both fares include a personal item but charge $40 per carry-on and $35 for the first checked bag.
So the baggage is the same either way? Give me the complete outbound totals and realistic arrival times in central Washington.

Yes. Three carry-ons add $120 and the shared checked bag adds $35, for $155 in baggage each direction. Thursday's airfare is $627 for three, or $782 including bags. After landing at 8:02 p.m., baggage claim and the trip into central Washington put you at a hotel around 9:00-9:30 p.m. Friday's airfare is $522, or $677 including bags, with a likely hotel arrival around 11:10-11:40 a.m.
Now compare the Sunday returns. We want to understand how much of Sunday each one preserves.

The midafternoon DCA-ORD nonstop leaves at 3:15 p.m. and arrives at 4:35 p.m. It is $186 per person, plus the same $155 total bag charges, for $713. You would want to leave central Washington around 12:45-1:00 p.m., so Sunday sightseeing would effectively end by lunch. The evening nonstop leaves at 7:40 p.m. and arrives at 9:02 p.m. It is $228 per person, or $839 including bags. That supports sightseeing until roughly 5:00 p.m., but after collecting the checked bag and getting home from ORD, you would likely arrive home around 10:30-11:15 p.m.
Show all four round-trip combinations. Keep the airfare and bag charges separate.

Thursday out plus Sunday afternoon back: $1,185 airfare, $310 bags, $1,495 total. Thursday out plus Sunday evening: $1,311 airfare, $310 bags, $1,621 total. Friday out plus Sunday afternoon: $1,080 airfare, $310 bags, $1,390 total. Friday out plus Sunday evening: $1,206 airfare, $310 bags, $1,516 total.
The Thursday and evening-return combination is $231 more than the cheapest, correct?
Correct. The cheapest is Friday morning with the Sunday afternoon return at $1,390. Thursday evening with the Sunday evening return is $1,621, a difference of $231.
I think that $231 buys quite a bit of time. Quantify the usable trip, including the hotel-night difference.

Thursday evening plus Sunday evening requires three hotel nights: Thursday, Friday, and Saturday. Thursday is essentially an arrival night, but Friday and Saturday are full days, and Sunday offers about five usable hours before leaving for DCA. Friday morning plus Sunday afternoon requires two hotel nights: Friday and Saturday. You would have roughly six to seven usable hours Friday after dropping bags, a full Saturday, and only the morning through lunch on Sunday. The longer combination adds Thursday night's lodging and yields approximately four to six more practical sightseeing hours overall, concentrated on Sunday, while avoiding a travel morning on Friday.
Use Thursday at 6:05 p.m. out and Sunday at 7:40 p.m. back for the hotel research. Keep the late Sunday home arrival visible because Owen has school Monday. No purchase yet.

Selected for planning only: Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee will use the Thursday, October 22 ORD-DCA nonstop at 6:05-8:02 p.m. and the Sunday, October 25 DCA-ORD nonstop at 7:40-9:02 p.m. Airfare is $1,311; three carry-ons and one shared checked bag add $310 round trip, for a $1,621 flight total. Expected Thursday hotel arrival is 9:00-9:30 p.m. The schedule provides full sightseeing days Friday and Saturday plus Sunday until about 5:00 p.m. It requires three hotel nights, October 22-25. Expected arrival home Sunday is approximately 10:30-11:15 p.m., which will remain part of the lodging and checkout analysis because Owen has school Monday. Nothing has been purchased.
